name: CupertinoButton
description: An iOS-style button that responds to touches with a fade-in/out effect. It is commonly used to create tappable controls that match the Cupertino design language.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget inside the button, usually a Text or Icon.

properties.name: onPressed
properties.description: The callback function that is called when the button is tapped. If null, the button is disabled.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The background color of the button.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: The padding inside the button around the child.

properties.name: borderRadius
properties.description: The border radius of the button for rounded corners.

properties.name: minSize
properties.description: The minimum size of the button.

properties.name: pressedOpacity
properties.description: The opacity of the button when pressed.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: The alignment of the child within the button.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: Internal padding for the button content.

properties.name: disabledColor
properties.description: The background color when the button is disabled (onPressed is null).

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for the widget.
